title: Relay and mailbox capacity refusals (429 RpcCapacity) leave no home failure record
outcome: When the relay home refuses a relay request for per-peer capacity (stage RpcCapacity, HTTP 429), the refusal is observable in the bounded home failure records. The wire status and the bounded retention are unchanged.
acceptance: A relay request refused for capacity produces one bounded homeRpcFailures record with stage rpcCapacity, while its wire reply stays the signed 429. The 5xx-only gates in federation_http_authenticate.rs and MailboxRelayHomeRpcFailures::note_with_phases admit exactly that stage. Shown by a behavioural test that saturates the per-peer bound.
No other 4xx refusal is recorded, and retention and redaction are unchanged. The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
